outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmap plots overlaid on tissue sections, not a bar chart or plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing individual patient tumor values (each dot = one sample) with median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are already displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual replicate data points (n=3) overlaid as dots for each group.
